description: mod-organizations-storage configuration template. Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-organizations-storage revision 15, image 5.0.0); see ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. mod-organizations-storage is an RMB storage module: it owns the organizations PostgreSQL schema and publishes organization audit events to Kafka through a transactional outbox. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-organizations-storage container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-organizations-storage container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-organizations-storage container in MiB

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size. Value taken from bugfest

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size. Value taken from bugfest

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Threshold for the first metaspace garbage collection (not a limit). Value taken from bugfest

deployment.description: mod-organizations-storage keeps no in-memory state, and the audit outbox is drained with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, so replicas can run side by side without double-publishing events.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient for single-record CRUD and paged CQL searches over organizations and related reference data.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL host; without it RMB cannot open the tenant schema

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL user (sourced from the secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL password (sourced from the secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per tenant pool. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 4

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: When set, RMB uses one connection pool of this size shared by all tenants instead of per-tenant pools

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Idle time in milliseconds after which a pooled connection is closed (RMB default; 0 keeps connections open)

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum lifetime in milliseconds of a pooled connection (RMB default)

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of reconnect attempts when a database connection cannot be established (Vert.x default 0)

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Interval in milliseconds between database reconnect attempts (Vert.x default)

EnvVars.name: DB_EXPLAIN_QUERY_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Queries slower than this many milliseconds are logged with their plan. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 1000

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER
EnvVars.description: Optional read-only replica host; when set, RMB routes read queries to it

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER
EnvVars.description: Port of the read-only replica; defaults to DB_PORT

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: PEM-encoded server certificate; when set, RMB connects to PostgreSQL over TLS

EnvVars.name: DB_ALLOW_SUPPRESS_OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING
EnvVars.description: Timestamp until which clients may bypass optimistic locking (used for data migrations); unset means never

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host for organization audit events

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor passed to the Kafka configuration (module default; not set on bugfest)

EnvVars.name: MAX_REQUEST_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum Kafka producer request size in bytes (module default)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: When set, audit events go to shared tenant-collection topics with this qualifier instead of per-tenant topics. Value taken from bugfest

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Okapi URL carried in the Kafka configuration (module default http://okapi:9130); not set on Eureka deployments

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Environment identifier used as the Kafka topic prefix (module default folio); must match the consumers of the audit topics

EnvVars.name: loadReference
EnvVars.description: Forces loading of reference data on tenant init regardless of the tenant parameter (env name is lowerCamelCase in code)

EnvVars.name: loadSample
EnvVars.description: Forces loading of sample data on tenant init regardless of the tenant parameter (env name is lowerCamelCase in code)

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the module process. -Dhttp.port=8082 moves RMB off its default port 8081, which the Eureka sidecar uses; it must match the sidecar's MODULE_URL. Heap sizing comes from the java block.

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Location of an external Log4j2 configuration overriding the bundled log4j2.properties; the bundled log4j2-json.properties can be selected for JSON logs

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the sidecar container in MiB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier; must match the other modules and sidecars of the deployment

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the sidecar process: the java block sizing plus -Dquarkus.http.host=0.0.0.0 and -Djava.util.logging.manager=org.jboss.logmanager.LogManager, as on bugfest

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-organizations-storage container is reachable from its sidecar

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-organizations-storage module deployed alongside this sidecar
